text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! To sweep around the outside 
on a line like that...! I have to cover 
this in my next column...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um, taking notes, taking notes... A pencil 
should be in my bag—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! My pencils... are scattered 
everywhere...!? Oh no... the inside of my 
bag is all pitch black..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Haaah............ I did it again. I gotta 
clean out my bag...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis looked totally dejected 
after the mountain of short golf pencils 
she always kept in her bag spilled out and 
badly stained the lining...
